SAN DIEGO COUNTY, CA
COMPREHENSIVE ORDINANCE LIST
Ordinances are laws adopted by the San Diego County Board of Supervisors, and usually amend, repeal, or supplement the County Code, Administrative Code, Compensation Ordinance, or Zoning Ordinance; provide zoning specifications; or appropriate money for specific purposes.
If you require a copy of any County Ordinance not available below, please contact the office of the Clerk of the Board of Supervisors, 1600 Pacific Highway, Room 402, San Diego, CA 92101 or call (619) 531-5434.
